+"""Password hashing helpers."""
+
+import hashlib
+import secrets
+
+
+def make_hash(password, salt=None):
+    salt = salt or secrets.token_hex(16)
+    digest = hashlib.sha256((salt + password).encode()).hexdigest()
+    return f"{salt}${digest}"
